bic_trace_step.reason: This commit introduces the vulnerable comparison in `io_poll_get_ownership()`: `if (unlikely(atomic_read(&req->poll_refs) >= IO_POLL_REF_BIAS))`. Since `atomic_read()` returns a signed 32-bit integer, and `IO_POLL_CANCEL_FLAG` is defined as `BIT(31)` (the sign bit), any value with the cancel flag set will be treated as negative. Thus, the comparison against `IO_POLL_REF_BIAS` (128) evaluates to false, bypassing the slowpath and incorrectly executing the fastpath.
